businesses.business: mobile payments and local payment methods

offering_description.value: Provides a payments network that lets consumers pay for digital goods and services using mobile carrier billing, digital wallets and local bank-based methods. Sells to large global merchants such as app stores, streaming and gaming companies. Also offers payouts and subscription management tools.

primary_products.value: carrier billing platform; digital wallet payment connections; subscription management tools; merchant payout tools

primary_services.value: payment processing; merchant payouts; subscription and fraud management; consumer identity and authentication

customer_segment.value: B2B: Global digital merchants: app stores, streaming, gaming, social and e-commerce companies, plus mobile network operators

end_markets.value: digital content and apps; online gaming; streaming media; e-commerce; telecommunications

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: percentage fees on payment volume processed for merchants; service fees: fees for payouts and related payment services
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: connects merchants with mobile operators, wallets and banks to process consumer payments; software / platform: operates payment network and merchant platform

geography_served.value: global: Operates in dozens of countries across Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: carrier billing, local payment methods, wallet payments and payouts

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to large digital merchants; partners / resellers: mobile network operators and wallet providers integrated into network

regulatory_exposure.value: high: payment institution and e-money licensing in UK and EU, regulated by FCA and similar financial regulators, plus anti-money laundering rules
